study: Prospective JEPA controller and completion-accounting repair
primary_comparisons: repair minus legacy for each family/cost (four), plus repaired frozen JEPA minus repaired RadioMap for each cost (two). Keep six-test budget if a cost is vetoed.
development: No tuning/selection. Per cost, stop confirmation if either family mean repair-minus-legacy loss exceeds 0.01 absolute (one percentage point), or integrity/paid-cost/consumption checks fail. Recompute from raw archives. Otherwise fixed repair proceeds.
execution_order: Fixed seeded random permutation within each site block; complete that site before next, same two workers. Archive order before first new world.
source_scope: Previous semantic/selected results, weights, timing and diagnoses already observed. Registration precedes only NEW development/confirmation. No training. Earlier failed results and unused original reservations unchanged.
model_choice: Original frozen three-member FleetJEPA (lowest prior fresh-test point means) and strong RadioMap fixed package comparators. No objective/architecture claim; prior compact negatives retained.
controller_legacy: Fast coarse OutageBudgetGate, slow OutageUtility30; reactive_rescue confidence with separate handover_admission applies to planned/reactive moves.
controller_exact_only: Fast-only secondary: exact fractional outage integral, same candidate scorer and separate all-handover admission. Not primary candidate or selection option.
controller_repair: Exact outage admission as planned roam_gate, no extra handover_admission; unchanged native low-RSSI/8dB-gain recovery can act after planned veto. Slow utility scorer and fast native scorer retained. Whole controller package changes previous intentional all-handover admission. Robot-local 100 ms watchdog after existing200ms control-silence stop threshold uses current pilots and completed local scans, independent of forecast arrival. Existing periodic due scans may start without control delivery after silence; fast emergency moves bypass cadence waiting and clear stale pending targets. All90ms scans and configured handover outages remain paid. Central RF reports still require successful control delivery.
runtime: ALL legacy/exact/repair main/fresh arms use SAME completion-safe queue: compute=max(reused sealed profile,predictor elapsed,measured history snapshot/forecast validation/storage/hash issue elapsed); service=compute+0.5s. Never release before actual accounted completion. Old profiles reused without retiming. Startup/loading separate.
timing_claim_contract: NEW prospective actual-cost experiment: profile exceedance is reported capacity diagnostic because actual cost is paid. Undercharge/premature consumption/nonfinite/source/causality/offline-replay failure veto experimental benefit. Previous global-overrun veto untouched. Production/hardware qualification always false.
controller_compute_scope: Admission/scorer CPU may be recorded but not individually scheduled; shared0.5s scheduling/other-work delay remains an assumption. Actual forecast issue measured. No full-stack real-time/hardware guarantee.
replays: First confirmation site all tested arms: recompute forecasts/packets with ORIGINAL main charged schedule as explicit OFFLINE trace replay; exact result/forecast/telemetry/action/decision/admission equality required. Separate fresh measured-cost reruns of same cases provide runtime sensitivity, not extra independent sites, not required bitwise equal. Paid-cost/consumption safety required for every fresh run; offline replay makes no remeasured deadline claim.
conditions: Even stationary/odd hidden drift; shared procedural CAD,60-second episodes,conditional60-second warm history,assumed scanning/localization/plans/native PHY curves.
